title: queue-purge-stale: remove pending entries with missing video files
rationale: Post-queue has 10 pending entries with score 50% from batch-produce runs (run-1774471249834, run-1774495319521) whose video files no longer exist on disk. go-live.ts now sorts file-exists above file-missing, so these 10 dead entries sit at the bottom but bloat the queue count (43 pending when only 33 are postable). Script: scan pending entries, check file existence, remove entries with missing files. Run once now, can be re-run after any pipeline cleanup.
success_criteria: Script reports how many entries were removed
Only removes pending entries with missing files (never touches posted/skipped)
Queue count drops from 43 to 33 after run

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/queue-purge-stale.ts: remove pending entries whose file path does not exist on disk
